Hi, I’m Joginder, the maker of Opal Reader. In this walkthrough, I show how you can read your books and keep your thoughts beside the page.

See Opal Reader’s features:
• PDF and DRM-free EPUB reading
• A notebook beside your book in Duo layouts
• PDF highlighting, underlining, notes, and drawing
• Compact layouts, plus iPhone and iPad support
• Three themes: Opal Light, Prism, and Midnight
